verdict.rationale: The only SDK-relevant evidence is a single first-party statement that most Azure service REST APIs have client libraries offering a native interface. That establishes official SDKs exist, but it is one thin mention with a 'most' caveat. The CLI, IaC and Terraform material is not SDK evidence and is not credited. Missing for 10: supported SDK languages, SDK documentation or repositories, coverage across all services, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
